title: Termination.
officialText:
The termination of chimneys or vents equipped with power exhausters shall be located a minimum of 10
feet (3048 mm) from the lot line or from adjacent buildings, unless otherwise approved by the Commissioner. The exhaust shall
be directed away from the building.
